agyos_skill.instructions: The **retrospective bridge** — read how an existing account has performed and turn it into a keep/kill/ refresh roadmap that feeds the forward plan. It **reads** (via `analytics-and-reporting`) and **recommends**; the human and other skills **act**. Plenty of accounts look busy — daily reels, carousels, likes trickling in, followers inching up — while **nothing actually moves.** A content audit finds the **signal under the busy-ness**: what gets *saved* and *shared* (not just liked), which pillars are starved or bloated, where the voice has drifted (or where your winners say it should **evolve**), and which profile fundamentals quietly leak followers. Strategy is forward-looking; the audit is the **retrospective reality-check** that informs it. 1. **brand-profile** + **voice-builder** — the voice/brand standard to audit against. 2. **content-pillars** + **social-strategy** — the intended plan (the audit checks execution of it). 3. **analytics-and-reporting** — the performance data source (WoopSocial post analytics for TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, YouTube, and Bluesky; native dashboards otherwise). (Depth: `references/the-audit-framework.md`.) - **A — Assemble the inventory:** ~90 days of output by platform/format/pillar/time + native metrics; pull the plan you're auditing against. - **U — Uncover the signal:** score on **saves/shares/replies + the goal-mapped KPI** (not vanity); surface top/bottom performers + patterns by format/time/pillar. - **D — Diagnose pillars, voice & profile:** pillar whitespace (→ content-pillars); voice drift **both ways** (→ voice-builder); profile fundamentals + cadence (→ profile-optimization). - **I — Iterate: keep / kill / refresh:** scale winners (→ content-recycling), cut chronic/off-brand/ non-native, refresh good-but-dated. **Refresh before kill; human approves kills.** - **T — Turn into a roadmap:** strengths/weaknesses/opportunities; **quick wins vs long-term**; owners + timelines; hand off. **No spreadsheet graveyard.** Audit = retrospective (vs forward strategy); signal-over-vanity; keep/kill/refresh; pillar whitespace; voice drift both ways; profile fundamentals; ~90-day window; quarterly deep + monthly light; run after major changes: `references/content-audit-2026-reality.md`.
